positions.role: Senior Full Stack Engineer — Platform Architecture & Data Security
positions.description: Own architecture and data security for a mobility/fintech platform serving riders, drivers, corporates and partners across East and Southern Africa.
achievements: Own the architecture of a money-moving platform: five Next.js surfaces and a mobile API behind one backend-for-frontend on a PHP monolith — 6,800+ unit tests and 280+ architecture decision records governing every change.

Designed and operate the atomic release rail: immutable releases activated by a symlink flip, a post-flip smoke that decides healthy / roll back, a release guard on money-path files, and detached self-logging deploys — one command, under a minute, one-command rollback.

Built card and mobile-money rails to PCI DSS SAQ-A scope: Mastercard Payment Gateway Services hosted sessions (card data never touches our servers), M-Pesa Daraja STK and B2C, MTN and Tigo — locality-locked rail resolution, fail-closed idempotency, signed and IP-allow-listed settlement callbacks.

Designed a cross-product trust-score engine: HMAC-signed idempotent event ingestion from partner products, a tamper-evident hash-chained ledger, a budget-guarded nightly recompute over ~40,000 users, and a flag-gated phased rollout across admin, rider portal and mobile.

Raised security posture end to end: key-only SSH with fail2ban, WebAuthn/TOTP MFA and reserved admin rights, audit hash-chains, gitleaks and blocking test gates in git hooks, purple-team pentest remediation, encrypted nightly off-box backups with restore drills.

Instrumented a legacy application with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki without coupling app code; root-caused a failover storm to a mis-sequenced reboot. Author the team's release and deploy standards; mentor through structured review.

positions.company: Ignite Energy Access (formerly ENGIE Energy Access)
positions.description: Owned CI/CD and quality infrastructure for a PAYG solar platform across seven African markets.
achievements: Owned end-to-end CI/CD and QA infrastructure across seven markets (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Mozambique, Côte d'Ivoire, Zambia) — testing standards, release gates and deployment workflows adopted across engineering.

Built automated end-to-end suites (Playwright, Cypress) over payment processing, token generation, subscriptions and IoT provisioning; moved regression from multi-day manual cycles to automated runs on every pull request.
Led the Rails 5 to 7.2 upgrade across the payment, PAYG token, IoT diagnostics, subscription and OTA firmware systems, spanning multi-tenant configurations for multiple markets.
Designed asynchronous token generation (RabbitMQ) and a Redshift payment-event pipeline, removing synchronous bottlenecks under peak billing load; led and grew a team of QA engineers.

positions.description: Founded and led engineering (concurrently with Baw Bab) for an ML security and robustness platform for software in and as medical devices (SiMD/SaMD).
achievements: Built the platform from scratch: CNNs, RAG and GNNs to detect adversarial attacks on ML models, evaluate robustness and surface gaps against healthcare ML regulation (HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, IEC 62304).

Architected an AWS event-driven backend in Python and Rust (PyO3) with a Go middleware layer for routing, rate limiting and fan-out; circuit-breaker and back-off patterns kept a live degradation invisible to customers.
Orchestrated ML pipelines with Airflow and tracked them end to end with MLflow — experiment versioning, model registry, reproducibility.

positions.description: Led engineering (concurrently with Vishnu Systems) for a digital-addressing platform for last-mile delivery in informal urban areas across Africa.
achievements: Built computer-vision pipelines over Azure, Google and OpenStreetMap satellite imagery to identify residential structures and convert them to Google Plus Codes at scale.
Piloted the platform with the Nairobi County Government — the second digital-addressing programme of its kind in Africa — integrating with county land-registry records.

Owned the full stack (React, Node.js, Kafka, MongoDB), the OpenAPI contracts and a Go backend-for-frontend separating field-agent mobile from county web; ran it on Azure, then hybrid Azure and GCP Cloud Run.

Refined service boundaries and data contracts with platform architects in a correctness-critical domain; defensive coding, integration testing, careful PostgreSQL migrations, OpenAPI and contract-test conventions for independent deploys.

Founded the Deveric mentoring initiative — structured mentorship for 15+ developers, 6+ advancing to mid or senior roles; earned 80+ technical certifications across cloud, backend, blockchain, AI/ML and security; shipped Go, Rust and Python projects in hackathons and open source.

Wrote low-level C and embedded assembly for streaming pipelines with deterministic store-and-replay and zero frame loss; designed fault-tolerant delivery with redundant paths, graceful degradation and self-healing recovery.

positions.description: Application-security platform — integrating SAST/DAST/SCA into enterprise CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchains.
achievements: Built integrations embedding security scanning into customers' CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps); contributed to the monolith-to-microservices decomposition on Spring Boot, JPA and Hibernate with HATEOAS REST APIs.
Owned the Visual Studio plugin (.NET / Windows) end to end, including the TLS 1.2 enforcement upgrade for regulated customers; every feature reviewed against the OWASP Top 10, aligned to NIST SSDF.
